wemoveProfile.vehiclePhotoUnit: Vehicle photo (will be shown to passengers)
wemoveProfile.step1Desc: Post your route with "New trip". Use the Share button to spread it on your networks and fill your seats faster.
wemoveProfile.step2Desc: From your dashboard you'll see who booked. Mark them as paid when you receive the money. When you depart, the route switches to "On the way".
wemoveProfile.step3Desc: When you arrive, press "Finalize trip". This closes the route and activates the link for passengers to rate you.
wemoveProfile.step4Desc: Every completed trip adds to your history. More positive reviews = more passengers. A verified profile builds trust automatically.
wemoveProfile.warn1: Your name, number, email and ID are registered to prevent fraud and dangerous situations.
wemoveProfile.warn2: More than 2 unjustified cancellations may result in account suspension. Contact support if you have an emergency.
wemoveProfile.warn3: Always respect your passengers and meet published schedules. Your reputation depends on it.
wemoveProfile.warn4: Don't post routes you can't fulfill. Passengers trust you.
